dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Deeply concave trailing edge with a non-linear curvature exhibiting several small, sharp notches and indentations along the posterior boundary.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: The apex exhibits a rounded shape classification with an obtuse angle transition at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: The convex anterior margin shows a steep angular descent of approximately 55 to 65 degrees relative to the horizontal base axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: The ratio of maximum horizontal base width to maximum vertical height is approximately 1.4:1.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of multiple white punctate markings or possible parasitic lesions across the lateral surface; visible notches and irregularities on the upper and mid-trailing edge.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-density distribution of small, white circular spots is localized primarily on the lower half of the visible fin surface.
